description: Rank top Hyperliquid perp wallets by PnL / ROI / win rate / volume / trade count within a time window. Use for questions like 'top HL traders with win rate > 75%' or 'best HL perp wallets last 7d'. Data comes from the same pipeline that backs vike.io/hyperliquid/wallets. Use win_rate expressed as percent (0-100). roi_pct is window realized PnL over the CURRENT account value (a unified or portfolio-margin wallet's whole value, native + builder + USDC outside them) and max_drawdown_pct is account-level and all-time (null when the wallet has too little equity history to say, and for those two modes), both in percent (12.5 = 12.5%).

min_win_rate.description: Minimum win rate as percent 0-100 (default 0 = no filter)
